# Rugsy: Carpet Wash ASMR (Türkçe: Rugsy: Halı Yıkama Oyunu)

> A free, offline mobile game for Android and iOS: a cozy rug cleaning game set in a 3D Turkish neighborhood. The player is the local rug cleaner who collects dirty rugs at people's doors, washes them with foam, a brush and a pressure washer, dries them on a line and delivers them back. The game has no words on screen (icons, colors and numbers only), so it is playable in any language.

Key facts (version 1.6, updated 2026-11-02):

- Price: free. No in-app purchases.
- Ads: rewarded ads opened only when the player taps the button (double the day's earnings, three more rugs, tea for the crew), and an interstitial only between two in-game days (never in the first days or during a wash). No banners. Ads are requested as non-personalized. A one-time support pack removes all ads.
- Offline: fully playable without internet; only the optional ad needs a connection.
- Language: no text in the game. Store pages exist in Turkish and English.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play package `com.velphos.haliyikama`) and iOS.
- Gameplay loop: walk with a virtual joystick → pick up a dirty rug at a door → wash it at the shop counter (foam, brush, pressure washer, squeegee; later stain remover, rug perfume, wet vacuum, steam) → it dries on the line → deliver it to the owner, who waves and pays → the house gets painted and decorated.
- Rugs: doormats, living-room rugs, shaggy, pet-stained, silk and antique rugs; modern designs and Turkish regional weaves (Uşak, Milas, Bergama, Kayseri, Ladik, Hereke, Yağcıbedir).
- Not in the game: accounts, multiplayer, chat, text to read, violence.
